question: average shuttle run improvement or decline per location, endline minus baseline
gold_sql: SELECT b."Location", AVG(e."Shuttle Run sec" - b."Shuttle Run sec") AS avg_shuttle_change FROM sportathon_baseline AS b JOIN sportathon_endline AS e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY b."Location" ORDER BY b."Location"

CURRENT QUESTION:
average shuttle run improvement or decline per location, endline minus baseline
attempts.response:
WITH
  baseline AS (
    SELECT
      "Location",
      AVG("Shuttle Run sec") AS baseline_shuttle_run
    FROM "sportathon_baseline"
    GROUP BY "Location"
  ),
  endline AS (
    SELECT
      "Location",
      AVG("Shuttle Run sec") AS endline_shuttle_run
    FROM "sportathon_endline"
    GROUP BY "Location"
  )
SELECT
  COALESCE(b."Location", e."Location") AS "Location",
  (e.endline_shuttle_run - b.baseline_shuttle_run) AS "Average Shuttle Run Improvement or Decline (sec)"
FROM
  endline e
  LEFT JOIN baseline b ON e."Location" = b."Location"
WHERE
  e."Location" IS NOT NULL;
